newsitem.title: EGYPT: Eastern extends share offer deadline.
newsitem.headline: Eastern extends share offer deadline.

text.p: Egyptian cigarette manufacturer Eastern Company has extended until Monday March 3 the deadline for bids for more than 10 percent of its equity, the company said in an official statement in al-Ahram newspaper on Thurday.
The deadline for tentative bids had previously been extended to February 27 from February 21, a source for the agents EFG-Hermes said earlier this week.
The source said at the time that big investors had made tentative bids for more than 10 percent of Eastern's equity.
The statement said bids must not be less than 96.00 pounds. The share closed at 100.8 pounds on Wednesday but was trading at 96.00 on Thursday.

As part of Egypt's privatisation programme the state's Holding Company for Mining and Refractories, which owns 80 percent of Eastern, is offering 10 to 20 percent of the equity to investors willing to buy at least 10,000 shares.
